purpose: Reuse existing general-person observation questions rather than generating ad-hoc body-feeling prompts around a known natal chart.

questions.recommendation: Investigate whether respondent recognizes an initial signal only after action, with later recall bias marked
Investigate when reason revises or overrides an initial bodily response, including cases where the change was later viewed as right or wrong
Investigate how physiological, interpersonal and affective context changes the clarity or prevalence of felt signals; do not suggest any substances or risky experiments
Observe low-stakes choices where both the immediate signal and action can be recorded before the result, not retrospectively inferred
